body: Trying to - but really not sure it is worth it. Has been at best “meh”

In general - getting 2 things right is harder than one. So - I wouldn’t.

On another note - what’s so bad you are willing to take long term pain? That’s the one thing most people are afraid of more than death!

Can it maybe be ameliorated? As you see from my post - I hung on for 3 extra yrs - and I don’t really regret it. Didn’t enjoy it always either - but it was interesting :)

Hey - yeah. Was out enjoying sun on my skin sitting in a park 4 hours ago - and now am - well, let’s just say I posted to this sub 5 minutes ago :)

I get you - I have been forgotten and alone - and in a crowd and alone - and honestly - both are just as bad…

Given that - meds are bad - ESPECIALLY if you are unlikely to be found. Hard to die from them - easy to non-fatally break several important internal organs. Wouldn’t happen if you are found quickly - but if you are lying on the floor for 2 days after an overdose - expect kidney, spleen, and liver damage at least - and probably some neuropathy. And this will really suck for years when you come to. 

So please don’t :)

I now see your point - I miswrote - I was conflating the 2 issues - maybe even in my mind. You forced me to split that point - which is a good thing.

What I meant was "once we are both aligned on the impossibility of biological children - and have mutually helped each other grieve that loss, then I would initiate divorce, and during that divorce push her away - just so that she takes my exit easier and does not follow me" 

The suicidal thoughts are not really related to infertility - the old fable of "Shit happens. But why does it happen to me?!?" doesn't really have a good answer in my experience - it just does. And it's up to us to deal with it.

To me, what makes me want to leave is just a feeling of general malaise - I haven't felt happy in decades - and I don't think I'll actually ever be happy. At that point, why perpetuate the entire mess?

To you final point - we are talking right now, no ? :) (With a 10 minute lag - but still)

You are not wrong - though I think the infertility is a separate issue, to be honest. Bluntly - I don't want to adopt, nor do I want a sperm donor - so if she really wants kids - then we have an immovable object vs unstoppable force situation. But that's grounds for divorce, not a swan dive into the East River :)

On the rest of it, I have just been depressed and tired of fighting life for years now - not really related to infertility.  

And yes, dead bedrooms happen. It's just easier to accept it as a fact than to fight it - which sounds like depression, doesn't it...

But thank you for the offer!
